project_type: React 18 + Vite 6 + TypeScript SPA with Tailwind CSS v4
build_system: Vite 6 with @tailwindcss/vite plugin; Tailwind v4 uses @import 'tailwindcss' in src/styles/tailwind.css (no tailwind.config.js); all source scanned via @source '../**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}'
test_framework: None configured — no test runner in package.json. Verification is via `npm run build` (vite build) in the FrontEnd directory.
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` inside e:\Thesis Software\FrontEnd. A clean exit (exit code 0) and no TypeScript errors confirms the build passes. Visual verification requires running `npm run dev` and checking each page in a browser at 320px, 480px, 768px, 1024px, and 1440px viewport widths.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell environment. All file paths use backslashes internally. The dev server is NOT required to run for build verification. Never restart a running dev server.
contribution_requirements: Mobile-first Tailwind classes; use responsive prefixes sm: md: lg: xl:. The three layouts (dashboard-layout, provider-layout, admin-layout) each have a fixed w-[280px] sidebar that must gain a mobile hamburger/Sheet drawer. All Table usages must gain an overflow-x-auto wrapper. No fixed pixel font sizes for headings. Grid layouts must stack on mobile.
key_patterns: 1. Layouts use `flex min-h-screen` with a fixed sidebar and `flex-1 ml-[280px]` main. The pattern to fix: add a Sheet (already imported in dashboard-layout) for mobile sidebar, hide desktop sidebar on mobile, show hamburger button in top bar on mobile. 2. Pages use `p-8` padding — replace with `p-4 md:p-8`. 3. Stats grids use `grid-cols-4` — change to `grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4`. 4. Tables everywhere have NO overflow wrapper — wrap every `<Table>` in `<div className='overflow-x-auto'>`. 5. The messages page uses `grid-cols-3` for chat UI with no mobile fallback — needs `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3`. 6. profile-setup uses `grid-cols-2` inside card with no responsive — needs `grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2`. 7. landing.tsx hero uses `grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-[1.2fr_0.8fr]` (already responsive), nav buttons need `hidden sm:flex` for text labels on very small screens. 8. The auth modals use `max-w-[400px] w-full mx-4` which is already safe.
directory_structure: e:\Thesis Software\FrontEnd\src\app\layouts\ — 5 layout wrappers; e:\Thesis Software\FrontEnd\src\app\pages\ — user pages at root, admin\ subdirectory, provider\ subdirectory; e:\Thesis Software\FrontEnd\src\app\components\ — shared components including ui\ (shadcn); e:\Thesis Software\FrontEnd\src\styles\ — index.css, tailwind.css, theme.css, fonts.css
